policy: Record only verified publications. v0.1.0-alpha is live on GitHub Releases, itch.io, Game Jolt, Google Play, the Amazon Appstore and the Microsoft Store (two listings). Every other destination is unpublished or unverified. Never infer publication from a local build, source push, upload or store record. Publication updates require a verified live URL/version/date and owner authorization.
